design.name: Keep postings in these places or remote
design.description: Rules out an on-site or hybrid posting outside the places you list; remote postings always pass.

settings.label: Places
settings.help: Cities, states or regions, separated by commas. A posting passes when its location contains one of them.

design.behavior: If setting1 is blank or arrangement (trimmed, lower-cased) is remote, pass. If location is blank, flag with the note: the posting does not state a location. If the lower-cased location contains any comma-separated, trimmed, lower-cased, non-empty place from setting1, pass. Otherwise exclude with the note: located in <location>.

cases.title: Data Engineer
